_note: V1 hand annotation of bundle_bologna_bcthip (ASME V&V 40), by Claude, written from Table 1's per-factor rationale cells. Only spans that verify verbatim inside a sentence surviving the furniture filter are kept -- the rest of Table 1 is verbless noun phrases the filter correctly drops as table content.
_granularity: Annotated at PACK granularity. The paper publishes ~20 sub-factors and the pack has 13, so several sub-factor rationales roll into one pack factor -- Test samples has four, Output comparison four. This is the reverse of every NASA 7009A document, where the published table is coarser than the pack.
_coverage_limit: Only the pack factors whose rationale survives are annotated. Bologna states its per-factor findings in a table rather than in prose, so factors whose cell is a bare noun phrase ('all key characteristics measured') have no annotatable evidence and are omitted rather than guessed at.
